note: Ceilings for bin/heimdall-footprint --check on the FULL tree: a measured number above its ceiling fails. They are the numbers measured on 2026-11-22 after the lean-core merge (17 agents, heimdall-lean among them; the main prompt agents/heimdall.md at 67,385 B; 56 hooks; the hook ceilings were then raised on purpose to 58 on 2026-11-24 for the two hooks added that day, read-dedup on PostToolUse Read and subagent-report-gate on SubagentStop, and to 59 on 2026-11-25 for plan-slice-hint on PreToolUse Read), exact and not rounded, so a hook, a skill or a byte of prompt added later fails the check until this file is raised on purpose. Disk is not budgeted here on purpose: tracked bytes in a dev checkout grow with every test, doc and hook-written journal commit, so a disk ceiling would turn red on unrelated work. A lean install tree has its own budget in the same schema, release/lean-install-budget.json, checked with --root DIR --budget FILE (the lean-core doc under docs/, section 'Measure it').
